purpose: Blind validation set for symmetry='crystal'. Drawn with a fresh seed from the sampling frame in fastpisa/reference/sampling.py and EXCLUDING every entry that informed any fitted constant (the 400-entry calibration draw and the 36 legacy benchmark entries), so no entry here has been seen by the model.
frame: see fastpisa/reference/sampling.py (X-ray, <=3.0 A, <=12000 atoms, >=2 polymer instances, released <=2018-06-30, 30% identity clusters)

measured_2026_10_04.note: Entries with >10% partial-occupancy heavy atoms (2izq, 4cc2) have a 33% median area error; the other 58 entries 0.91%. See 'Known limit' in CLAUDE.md.
